request.spec:
A claim can be commented (a text entry and a button on the claim; an empty comment is refused
with an error on the claim). Each comment is kept with the user who wrote it and the sheet's today
when it was written, shown on the claim in order as <user> on <date>: <text>, and written as
COMMENT_ADDED, naming the claim like every claim line and ending text=<text>. A viewer, an archived
sheet and the as-of view refuse it like any change.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A claim can be commented (a text entry and a button on the claim; an empty comment is refused
with an error on the claim). Each comment is kept with the user who wrote it and the sheet's today
when it was written, shown on the claim in order as <user> on <date>: <text>, and written as
COMMENT_ADDED, naming the claim like every claim line and ending text=<text>. A viewer, an archived

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Claims can now be commented on, and `bin/e2e` passes all 4 acceptance tests.

**What changed**
- **Stored data:** a new migration, `V57__claim_comment.sql`, adds a `claim_comment` table. Each comment keeps who wrote it, the sheet's today when it was written, and its text, oldest first. The as-of view's history picks up the new table without any change.
- **Server:**
  - `Claim` holds the list of comments (`ClaimComment.java` is the new class for one comment).
  - The new `ClaimService.comment` method trims the text and refuses an empty comment. A viewer or an archived sheet is refused the same way as any other change.
  - Each comment writes a `COMMENT_ADDED` audit line: the usual claim fields, then `number=` when the claim has one, ending with `text=<text>`.
  - There is a new `POST /api/claims/comment` endpoint, and comments are now included when claims are returned.
  - The as-of view already refuses anything that isn't a read, so commenting there is refused too.
- **Front end (`claims.ts`):** each claim lists its comments as `<user> on <date>: <text>` (`claim-comments-line`), with a text box (`claim-comment-text`) and a button (`claim-comment-add`). An empty comment or a refused one shows `claim-error`, and typing in the box clears the error.

**One fix outside the request:** the as-of view was rejecting the request that lists a sheet's tags (`/api/claims/tags`), because it wasn't on its list of read-only requests. That broke loading the sheet in the as-of view, so scenario 2 couldn't see the people it expected. I added it to the read-only list in `AsOfFilter.java`. This was already wrong before my change, but the new test needs it fixed.
